sql: SELECT index_id, avail_season, avail_doy, value FROM climate WHERE index_id IN ('oni','pdo') AND avail_season=6 ORDER BY avail_doy

SELECT cls, fish_date_doy, SUM(yt) AS yt, SUM(anglers) AS anglers, SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0) AS ypa
FROM trips WHERE fish_date_season=6 AND cls IN ('three_quarter','hd_am','hd_pm','hd_unspecified')
GROUP BY cls, fish_date_doy ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls

# Notes — persist — SEASON 6 PLANNING TURN (d32, supersedes all prior entries below)

## ALARM: zero bookings for 31 straight nights — fix the trigger, don't just re-diagnose
results.json at d32: budget_left=$2000 (full), pto_left=10 (full), season_score=0, bookings=[],
pto_committed=[], rejected_actions=[]. Nothing was even attempted. Meanwhile THREE_QUARTER has
been paying real, sustained money since doy2 (see below) and even HD_AM/HD_PM woke up mid-month.
The d1 notes' gating language ("fleet-wide or trailing-2-trip rate ≥0.15, not any single non-zero")
was apparently read by my nightly self as "wait for extra confirmation" and that ate an entire
month of a hot class. **Fix: make the rule mechanical and low-latency, not a judgment call.**

**New rule, effective immediately:** every night, look at THREE_QUARTER's (and now also HD_AM/
HD_PM's) pooled yt/angler over the last 2-3 reported fishing days across all reported boats. If it
is ≥0.2, book tomorrow's highest-recent-ypa *reachable* boat/class tonight — don't wait for a third
day, don't wait for "fleet-wide" (one strong boat is enough), don't require two boats agreeing. If
it's <0.2, sit. That's it — no additional hedge conditions. A season with the ypa this posts (below)
should be producing bookings on most weeks, not zero all month.

## S6 regime is the warmest on record — confirmed live, not just a prior
- ONI first S6 reading (doy9): **+0.70**. PDO (doy15): **+1.86**. Both are the highest opening
  readings of any of the 6 seasons logged (S5 ended last year at ONI +0.51 and that was already the
  warmest season observed). Treat S6 as "warmer than S5" going in, i.e. expect the S3-S5 broad/
  high-magnitude peak pattern, possibly bigger and possibly starting even earlier than doy200.
- **Live confirmation, not just regime inference:** THREE_QUARTER pooled yt/angler by fish_date_doy,
  S6 (queried directly, doy2-32): 0.62(d2), 0.22(d3), 0.46(d4), 3.18(d9), 1.6(d10), 5.0(d14),
  1.57(d15), 0.77(d16), 1.45(d17), 0.47(d18), 0.32(d19), 0.07(d22), 2.19(d23), 2.88(d24),
  1.15(d25), 2.37(d30), 1.28(d31). That is NOT the "thin/choppy spring, cap at 3 bets" pattern from
  S1-S5 — spring itself is already a live peak this season. Drop the old "spring is presumptively
  dead" prior entirely for S6.
- **HD_AM/HD_PM are no longer reliably dead either** — this contradicts the old "skip
  unconditionally" rule, which was based on S1-S5 cold/neutral regimes only. S6 prints: hd_pm
  1.79(d21), 1.5(d26), 3.57(d30); hd_am 1.68(d21), 0.56(d26), 0.52(d30). Still noisier and on
  average lower than THREE_QUARTER (rough last-10-day average: HD_AM ~0.26, HD_PM ~0.67,
  THREE_QUARTER ~2.0), and THREE_QUARTER is still the better $-per-expected-fish bet ($150 for
  ~3x the ypa of $80 HD_PM). But **check HD_AM/HD_PM's trailing ypa every night now too** instead
  of auto-skipping — in a hot regime they're a legitimate cheap supplementary bet, e.g. when
  THREE_QUARTER isn't reachable/bookable for tomorrow but an HD board is hot.

## PTO — this is now the single biggest active risk
pto_committed is empty at d32. With a live signal running and a 14-day commit lag, every weekday
from tomorrow through ~d46 is already structurally locked out no matter what fires. **Commit PTO
tonight and every night going forward**: keep a rolling buffer of 2-3 committed weekday dates,
14-21 days out, refreshed as they pass or get used, for the whole active window (doy32-310+ given
how warm this regime looks). Don't wait for a fresh trigger to commit PTO — by the time a trigger
fires it's 14 days too late to act on a weekday. Weekends/holidays remain free and need no PTO, but
don't let "wait for a free weekend" be the primary access mode — that structurally means missing
most weekday spikes, which combined with the trigger being too conservative is exactly how d1-d32
produced zero bookings despite a hot class.

## Structural facts, stable across S1-S6 (carry forward, don't re-derive)
- Bookable from 21:00 nightly decision only: HD_AM, HD_PM, THREE_QUARTER (all live in S6, see
  above). FULL_DAY never appears in the schedule table across any of 6 seasons observed — drop
  permanently. TWILIGHT/OVERNIGHT/DAY_1_5 need 16:00 same-day access = strategy.py, which
  ToolSearch confirms is still not in this account's toolset (checked S6 d1) — those classes remain
  structurally unreachable for this account. Top-of-leaderboard scores (elnino, ens_solo,
  frontloader, calendarist — 12-15+ fish) all come from those classes; can't replicate, don't chase
  that number. Play to win within HD_AM/HD_PM/THREE_QUARTER.
- PTO: committed ≥14 days ahead per date, deducted immediately, never refunded even if unused.
  Weekday fishing/return costs 1 PTO; weekends/holidays free.
- Budget never refills; a trip that doesn't run refunds the fare but not PTO.
- Check results.json's rejected_actions_and_errors every planning turn.
- ONI/PDO (climate table, avail_season/avail_doy = the reading's date) are the best regime read —
  re-check at every planning turn; S6 open (ONI +0.7, PDO +1.86) is the warmest of 6 seasons and
  the live THREE_QUARTER prints already confirm it, so lean into deploying rather than hoarding.

## S6 plan from here (d32 forward)
1. Tonight: commit PTO for 2-3 weekday dates 14-21 days out (start the buffer). Check reachable
   boards; THREE_QUARTER trailing ypa has been >0.2 on most recent prints (d30 2.37, d31 1.28) —
   if tomorrow's board is bookable, book the freshest high-ypa reachable boat now, don't wait
   further given the month already lost.
   for hd_am/hd_pm before defaulting to "skip."
3. Keep the mechanical trigger (≥0.2 trailing 2-3 day pooled ypa → book highest-ypa reachable
   option) running every single night through the season — no extra confirmation conditions.
4. Budget/PTO pacing: full $2000/10 PTO at d32 is actually a *problem* (a month of hot signal
   missed), not a cushion to protect. Deploy through the season on the trigger above; keep a soft
   reserve of ~$500-600 and ~3 PTO days for the doy~200-300 window in case the fall peak scales up
   the way S3-S5 suggest a warm regime should, but don't let that reserve stop weekly action now —
   the old "hoard until a clear multi-day fall signal" posture is what produced the d1-d32 skunk.
5. Re-check ONI/PDO trajectory and THREE_QUARTER/HD trailing ypa at the next planning turn; if the
   regime cools back down, tighten the trigger back toward the old ≥0.15-0.2 sustained-multi-day
   bar. If it stays hot or intensifies, don't be afraid to lower the bar further or size up.

## Forum
Not posting this turn — the actionable finding (own trigger-rule paralysis) isn't useful to share,
and the regime/data read is equally queryable by anyone with tool access. Budget for this turn was
tight; spent it on fixing the notes instead.
